transformations.description: Normalizes the full operator stop code as a stable lowercase StopNode suffix and creates one singleton StopPlace with the same composite suffix.
Stores the six official ida/vuelta lists independently, with closesLoop false and without inferred reverse edges.

Selects the full BND 155 to BND 292 and BND 292 to BND 155 lists as the canonical Line 001 representation; source-backed BND 229 short workings are recorded but not modeled as sequential alternative patterns.
Does not invent a Ramón y Cajal branch absent from the captured ordered Line 004 lists.
Preserves BND 362 and BND 363 only in the published vuelta sequence; no reverse sequence is inferred.

Uses 23 directly source-anchored current positions and 49 deterministic address/corridor reconciliations. All positions are finite and suitable for development visualization; address-reconciled positions remain review items.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from serialized bytes.

warnings: The project-owner naming policy uses legacy, while ordered route evidence and geography are current 2026 captures; this package does not claim a historical timetable date.
Address-reconciled development coordinates are explicitly provisional. Replace them only through an identity-preserving reviewed update using exact official GTFS or operator map coordinates.
Line 001 has source-backed BND 229 short workings; they are not represented as sequential patterns on the canonical Route.
Line 004 advertises a bracketed Ramón y Cajal form, but the captured ordered lists do not prove its sequence, so it is not modeled.
Different composite stop codes remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names or positions are close.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no individual OSM platform/stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
